title: New Member Share on Prescription Insurance on File Corrected Claims
content:
**Prescription Insurance on File** gives a new member of the plan a member share on a corrected claim, measured in whole months from the coverage's effective date to the day the corrected claim is made.

## Rule

| Whole months from the coverage's effective date to the corrected claim | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Less than one whole month | 0.9 |
| One to 2 whole months | 0.95 |
| More than 2 whole months | 1 (no member share) |

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent is made once, on the final patient pay.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical: coverage effective 15 March)

| Corrected claim made on | Whole months since 15 March | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 14 April | 0 | 0.9 |
| 15 April | 1 | 0.95 |
| 14 June | 2 | 0.95 |
| 15 June | 3 | 1 |

## Question answered

*The coverage was added to the profile weeks after its effective date. Which date counts?* The coverage's effective date, not the day the record was added.
